# Chris-Micthomas School Management System - Android App Build

## Goal
Wrap the existing web-based school management system in a native Android WebView app, producing a buildable Android Studio project (APK).

## Steps
- [x] 1. Create Gradle project config (settings.gradle, build.gradle, gradle.properties)
- [x] 2. Create Gradle wrapper properties
- [x] 3. Create app module build.gradle
- [x] 4. Create AndroidManifest.xml with permissions
- [x] 5. Create MainActivity.java WebView host
- [x] 6. Bundle web assets into assets/www (index.html, css, js, img)
- [x] 7. Create Android resources (strings, colors, styles, adaptive launcher icon)
- [x] 8. Final verification of project structure
